summary: Extend the selected-agent details proposal with an execution tree and typed activity and health observations

replay.detail: Documentation only. No claim admission, replay, or child lifecycle producer changes.

schema.detail: Execution identities, child inventory, observations, and capabilities are proposed wire sketches. No stored or wire schema or generated client changes.

rules.detail: Summary and transcript retention horizons remain design questions. No checkpoint rules, retention rules, or upgrade requirements change.

compatibility.detail: Existing agent details, subagent DTOs, conversations, and subscriptions remain unchanged. The documentation proposes durable finished-child summaries, separately expiring content, owner-routed child follow, Known/Unknown facts, and adapter Support without advertising them as shipped.

downtime.detail: No runtime change or deployment is required.

manual.detail: No configuration, state conversion, or client migration is required.

recovery.detail: No stored state changes or rollback conversion.
